label: paper
design: Quiet editorial default. Stone greys, indigo accent, geometric sans. Generous space, hairline rules, nothing shouts. This is the floor the site is judged against — if a page has no reason to be themed, it is this.
language: Plain and specific. Short sentences. State the fact, then the consequence. No superlatives, no hedging.
use_for: About, Writing, Contact, 404, and any page without a stronger reason.
note: The only theme that adapts to the reader. It is the one with no institution to be faithful to, so it defers to prefers-color-scheme through light-dark(). Every colour it defines has both values.
